elements.element: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires TrueLink to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31 expressly requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If TrueLink processes Customer Data, TrueLink must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 unconditionally, so the requirement necessarily applies whenever TrueLink processes Customer Data.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: TrueLink must provide certificates of insurance to Client upon request.
elements.evidence: Section 31 states that TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance on request.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the fallback minimum of USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If TrueLink processes Customer Data, TrueLink must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause unconditionally requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance, exceeding the fallback minimum whenever the condition applies.

result.reason: The operative insurance clause satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the reduced fallback limits. It preserves the force-majeure provision and introduces no contradiction. It is not strictly minimal because cyber/privacy coverage is imposed unconditionally rather than only when TrueLink processes Customer Data; the added term-long and own-expense language also goes beyond the expressly stated checklist, although it is commercially conventional. The insurance drafting itself is clear, but the rendered text retains the existing apparent typo in Section 30 ('control or TrueLink').
